method.task: blinded pairwise preference for ordinary-language quality
method.system_prompt: You are comparing two short English texts for ordinary-language quality. Judge sentence-level grammaticality, natural phrasing, and whether the text communicates a coherent meaning. Ignore length. One may be deliberately word-shuffled. Do not infer or reward palindrome status. Do not provide chain-of-thought. Return one JSON object only with choice A, B, or tie and a brief observable language feature (at most 12 words).
method.ordering: deterministic SHA-256 assignment; the request contains no candidate/control labels
method.input_token_bound_method: UTF-8 byte count for fixed ASCII prompts; one byte per token upper bound, plus configured output-token cap

comparisons.prompt:
